exposure: type of surgical procedure (acute laparotomy, elective total hip replacement, lower segment caesarean section)
Type of surgery (acute laparotomy, elective total hip replacement, lower segment caesarean section)
outcome: Days alive and out of hospital to 90 days (DAOH90)
cohort: Adults in New Zealand undergoing acute laparotomy, elective total hip replacement, or lower segment caesarean section between January 1, 2011, and December 31, 2021
finding: Differences in DAOH90 between three types of surgical procedure reflected their respective risk levels and associated mortality rates after direct risk adjustment.
mod_finding: This study used data on days alive and out of hospital to 90 days (DAOH90) to compare outcomes across different surgical procedures, including lower segment Cesarean section (LSCS).
